With torrential rain providing testing conditions, Leeds United hosted Manchester United on a day where a win would be crucial for both sides. First half headers from Harry Maguire and Bruno Fernandes put the Red Devil's 2-0 up at halftime. But at the start of the second half, Leeds turned the game around and made it 2-2 thanks to goals from Rodrigo and then Raphinha just a minute later. But subs Fred and Anthony Elanga came off the bench to fire Manchester United to a 4-2 lead and secured the victory for Ralf Rangnick's side.
